lines.text: Jesus withdrew with His disciples to the sea, followed by a large crowd from Galilee, Judea, Jerusalem, and other regions.
Jesus asked His disciples to have a boat ready so the crowd would not crush Him.
The unclean spirits fell before Jesus and cried out, "You are the Son of David," but He warned them sternly.
Jesus went up on the mountain, called those He wanted, and appointed twelve apostles to preach and drive out demons.
Jesus named Simon Peter, and He named James and John Boanerges, meaning "Sons of Light."
